acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Pre-production has independent database, Redis, secrets, environment variables, deployment, domain, and observability, with no production data or credentials reused.
Provider credentials are backend-only, encrypted at rest with managed-key separation, and absent from frontend, URL, logs, evidence, and telemetry.
Credential rotation is demonstrated without plaintext exposure, data loss, or unauthorized access.
OAuth and credential revocation is demonstrated, audited, and effective within the approved response window.
Tenant isolation passes authorized reads and cross-tenant read/write denial tests.
Gray scope is fail-closed at one tenant, one shop, and no more than 100 SKUs; configuration alone cannot expand it.
Real Provider authentication succeeds only in the approved independent pre-production or dual-approved gray scope.
The real read golden path returns schema-validated, normalized, tenant-scoped inventory data through InventoryProviderPort.
Timeouts, rate limits, HTTP 429/5xx, token expiry, and refresh failure have bounded safe handling; any connection-level retry is limited to idempotent GET and does not create a new business run.
Provider failures map to safe internal errors without credential, token, or raw-response leakage.
Unauthorized real inventory write is impossible at L0-L2; mutation code and production mutation endpoints are unreachable, UI write capability is absent, and inventoryMutationEnabled=false.
PostgreSQL backup integrity and recovery-point evidence demonstrate measured RPO no greater than 15 minutes.
A timed restore/PITR drill demonstrates application consistency and measured RTO no greater than 60 minutes.
Deployment and migration rollback are demonstrated from controlled failure without production impact.
The Provider kill switch stops all real-provider calls within the frozen response target and fails closed.
Tenant and shop kill switches isolate only the selected scope and deny disabled scope.
Read and write kill switches are independently testable; the write switch remains disabled for initial Production Ready.
Threat review, sensitive scan, SAST, dependency scan, container scan, permission review, and adversarial verification have no unresolved blocking finding.
An exclusive dedicated host completes a fresh fixed B1-C1-C2-B2 validation matrix with valid comparability evidence.
At least three repeat runs provide P50/P95/P99, throughput, error rate, concurrency, CPU, memory, database-pool, and Provider-limit evidence meeting SLOs frozen before G1.
The approved long-running stability period plus soak, repeated demo, race, and cleanup checks pass on the dedicated host.
Provider, OAuth, inventory sync, binding backlog, database, host, and security-denial telemetry is queryable and trace/audit correlated.
Actionable alerts fire and recover during controlled Provider, OAuth, database, scope, and security failures.
G0 and read-only G1 satisfy frozen entry, exit, observation, metric, rollback, kill-switch, and incident requirements within one tenant, one shop, and 100 SKUs.
Gray Go is recorded only when Owner Approval=true and Technical Lead Approval=true; CI cannot replace either approver.
Release integrity binds source, artifacts, configuration, migrations, acceptance evidence, and the repository baseline disposition.
Owner explicitly approves Production Ready only after technical sign-off, operations/security sign-off, and the final production gate pass.

If a later separate Owner decision approves controlled writes, each operation requires one manual confirmation, expected revision, idempotency, tenant/shop allowlists, audit, and a write kill switch; automatic, bulk, or silently retried mutation remains forbidden.
